Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a multicolor green or red Digimon card?

Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon or any of your Tamers would digivolve into multicolor green or red Digimon cards, reduce the digivolution costs by 1.
Inherited Effect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, it checks security before the attack ends.)
